gen-dafont-nordic-gf-pridi: Ancient and weighty, Nordic spaces its closed letters far apart. Pridi follows with a text serif whose small letters stand nearly capital-tall, so a long page of it moves along without strain.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, its tall a, e and s opening wide. Nordic sits above it with cramped, closed letters, and the gap between tight heading and open serif gives the page its tension.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum is a dignified serif with a very open c and a high, squared-off lowercase. Nordic is best at tight, closed, monoweight force; this one is best at breathing.
gen-dafont-nordic-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads clean and modern, with a gentle cap-to-lowercase step. Its strokes never vary in weight, so a long passage glides along quietly beneath the cramped, closed, brushy Nordic heading.
gen-dafont-nordic-mulish: Mulish reads soft and approachable, with no thick-and-thin at all. Nordic brings its tight, ancient, closed letters to the top, and the sans below opens them out like a horseshoe magnet.
gen-dafont-nordic-rubik: Nordic opens with ancient, powerful letters, tightly closed and spaced like brush dabs set far apart on paper. Rubik below is soft and clear, its lowercase big and round.
gen-dafont-nulshock-bitter: Technical and stretched out, Nulshock draws its outline with no swelling in the bowls. And Bitter, a dependable slab-serif with a huge lowercase eye, carries a long page in a grounded, easy way.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-epunda-slab: Nulshock leads with stretched, monoline capitals. It is best at bold technical statements, while Epunda Slab, a dignified serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, is best at quiet, steady text.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-fauna-one: Nulshock stretches its unshaded, zero-modulation outline wide and spacious across the top, bold and technical. Fauna One, a literary serif with a tall middle band, settles in beneath it.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-glegoo: Nulshock spreads out its stretched, unshaded curves that never thin at the shoulders. And Glegoo, with big counters and wide, unclosed mouths, gives the pair a refined, editorial openness.
